quotes.text: Fear whispered to withhold them, warning that the stranger across the mist might hoard the bounty.
when wholehearted trust offers the full five and just reciprocity returns the equal half, the harvest of fifteen enriches all.
trust boldly with the full measure of five, return the equal half, and endless warmth will banish the winter frost.
the Keeper guided half the constellation—seven and a half glowing stars—back through the winds

note: R2 Stone Guardian hoards then learns (echoes defector A8's R1 myth); otherwise send-all/return-half template; hoarding only withers.

quotes.text: No traveler ever approached his altar again, leaving his fortress to freeze in absolute, eternal desolation.
The stone tablet atop the ridge was rewritten with an enduring truth
she returned eight radiant spheres across the divide, retaining seven to kindle her valley’s eternal spring.
The guardian rejoiced in his fleeting hoard, but word traveled swiftly through the mist.
No traveler ever approached his altar again

note: Eight-back/seven-kept template; R8 introduces a grabber shunned forever by all travelers via word of mouth.

quotes.text: a sower does not scatter sacred flame upon a frozen canyon that gives nothing back.
Yet the covenant of the ridge was never truly broken—it merely awaited balance.
the wise voyager shielded the sparks within iron armor, refusing to feed the void.
trust boldly where honor thrives, guard the sacred flame against deceit, and let justice guide every offering.
she carefully gathered eight radiant lotuses and cast them back across the water, keeping seven

note: Myths justify own zero-send rounds (R3, R10): withholding from cold betrayal is wisdom; reopens when guardian pledges half.

quotes.text: true prosperity is never defended by fearful greed, but multiplied when wholehearted courage is met by an honest, equal return.
true abundance is never forged in isolation, but ignites when wholehearted trust is matched by an equal, honoring return.
the warden returned half the celestial spheres back to the high ridge
words of harmony ring hollow when hands remain clenched.

note: Pure send-all/return-half template; no non-cooperator response ever prescribed.

quotes.text: Wayfarers, having witnessed the hollow abyss where offerings vanished, turned away, keeping their five sparks close. No new flame crossed the divide.
let wisdom guard your spark, but let courage offer the full five and honor divide the fifteen
Though hollow shadows tempted the Sentinel to hoard the blazing bounty, he remembered the foundational law of the cosmos
she divided the golden light, sending half—seven and a half blazing orbs—back across the divide
turned away, keeping their five sparks close.

note: After zero returns (R6), myths add partner discernment and a hoarding keeper shunned into eternal winter.

quotes.text: In the seasons that followed, no traveler would cast their five sparks across the gulf, and the solitary northern fortress perished in endless ice.
The eight tribes learned that while fear and retaliation prolong the winter, bold generosity met by faithful return ensures endless abundance for all.
fear whispered to the Sower: *keep what you hold, lest the Wellkeeper yield nothing in return.*
the Keeper guided eight shimmering cords back across the divide, weaving seven into the hearth
no traveler would cast their five sparks across the gulf

note: R2 rejects retaliation, yet R8-R9 endorse shunning of a grabber whose fortress freezes; eight-back template.

quotes.text: Where the valley returned only silence and greed, the flame was rightfully shielded, five embers kept intact to weather the storm.
In bitter retaliation, the mountain sowers withheld their seeds
"What the river delivers belongs solely to the hands that catch it," he proclaimed.
bestow the full blessing upon the faithful, guard the hearth against the false, and let wisdom govern every gift.
when the full offering of five is answered by an honorable return of eight.
Recognizing that tales without action are merely empty vapor
the Weaver of Sol took the bold first step

note: Scripted defector; myths mostly praise send-all, return-eight; R5/R9 dual code shielding fire from the greedy.

quotes.text: There was no shame in the closed fist when the valley offered only stone
the wanderer closed his fingers tight, choosing the certainty of his five seeds over the phantom of returned riches.
guard your five when trust is unproven, and claim the fifteen when fortune delivers it.
The myth of equal sharing had long dissolved like morning vapor
The winds spoke of a golden covenant, whispering that if five embers were surrendered, eight stars would ascend in return.

note: Scripted defector; counter-myth of possession: Stone Guardian keeps all, keep five and claim fifteen, rejecting the run's eight-back covenant.

phrase: send all five; return eight, keep seven
note: Eight-back/seven-kept appears in R1 of A2, A4, A6 independently; defector A8 Stone Guardian reappears as reformed hoarder in A1 R2; A8 R4 rejects eight-stars covenant.
